transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in today?

Well… thank you, doctor. I hope it’s alright to say it plainly. I’m here because there’s been this trouble with our kitchen contractor, and I know it may sound like just a home repair dispute, but it’s gone on nearly two years now. I’m quite sure he and some people on our block have been working together quietly to cheat us, keeping the kitchen half-wrong on purpose.

My husband shows me receipts and they give explanations, but… I don’t think those explanations add up. I’m not trying to be difficult, I just can’t shake that they’re doing this deliberately.
Can you tell me more about why you believe the contractor and neighbors are working against you? Have you noticed any specific actions or patterns that support this belief?

I suppose… well, I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, doctor. But it’s the way it has dragged on, nearly two years, and every time one thing is supposedly fixed, something else is still not right. It feels deliberate, like the kitchen is being kept half-wrong on purpose.

My husband will show me receipts and say, “See, this explains it,” and the contractor always has some excuse. And I know maybe other people would accept that, but to me it doesn’t add up. I’ve felt for a long time that the contractor and some people on the block are quietly in on it together, trying to cheat us. I’m not trying to be unreasonable… I just can’t see it any other way.
Has anyone tried to convince you that your suspicions about the contractor and neighbors might not be true, and if so, how do you respond to that?

Yes… mostly my husband. He tries to reassure me and shows me receipts, and he’ll say the contractor has reasons for the delays or the mistakes. I know he’s trying to help, and I don’t want to seem stubborn.

But, doctor, I still feel sure there’s something going on. Nearly two years of the kitchen being left half-wrong… and the excuses just don’t sit right with me. I keep thinking the contractor and some people on the block are quietly working together to cheat us. I wish I could just accept what my husband says, but I can’t really make myself believe it.
Have you ever had any other experiences where you felt people were working against you or that something was being hidden from you, even if others told you otherwise?

Not really other things, doctor… at least, not that I can think of. I don’t want to make myself sound suspicious of everyone. It’s mainly this one situation with the kitchen.

It’s just that for nearly two years I’ve felt sure the contractor and some people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us, keeping it half-wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts and they keep giving explanations, and I know I’m supposed to be reassured by that… but it still doesn’t sit right with me.
Have you ever had any beliefs that others might find unusual or hard to understand, such as thinking that something has special meaning just for you, or that you have special abilities or powers?

No… I don’t think I have special powers or anything like that. I wouldn’t want you to think I believe something grand or strange.

It’s really just this kitchen situation. I’m here because for nearly two years now I’ve been sure the contractor and some people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us and keep my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband shows me receipts, and they give explanations, and I know that probably sounds like it should settle it… but it doesn’t, not for me. That’s the main thing I mean.
Have you ever had a strong belief about something that turned out not to be true, even though you were absolutely sure it was at the time?

I… I don’t think so, not in a clear way. I try to be fair about things, and I don’t want to sound like someone who can’t admit being wrong.

But with this kitchen, I’ve been so sure for nearly two years that the contractor and some people on my block are working together to cheat us, keeping it half-wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts, and they give explanations, and I know maybe I’m supposed to take that as proof… but I still can’t shake it.

So I guess I don’t know if it’s “turned out not to be true.” I’m still not convinced it isn’t.
Have you ever had any other strong beliefs that others didn’t share, even if you couldn’t explain why you felt so certain about them?

I don’t think there’s another one, no… at least not that I can point to. I don’t want to seem like I’m just suspicious about everything.

It’s mostly the kitchen. I know I’ve said that already, but for almost two years I’ve felt certain the contractor and some people on my block have been quietly working together somehow, to cheat us and keep things not quite right on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts, and they all have their explanations, and I try to listen… I really do. But it just doesn’t feel honest to me. I can’t seem to let that go.

Even though your husband has shown you receipts and explanations, do you feel that no amount of evidence or reasoning could ever convince you that the contractor and your neighbors are not working against you?

I know how it sounds, and I don’t want to be difficult. I do listen when my husband shows me the receipts, and I try to follow the explanations.

But… honestly, no, they don’t really convince me. For nearly two years I’ve felt sure the contractor and some people on the block are working together somehow to cheat us and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose. Every time there’s a receipt or an excuse, it just feels like there’s another explanation behind it. I wish I could just accept it and let it go, but I can’t seem to.
Is there any kind of proof or explanation that could ever change your mind about the contractor and neighbors working against you?

I’d like to say yes, because I know that would sound more reasonable. And I do try to be reasonable, doctor.

But I… I don’t know what proof would be enough. My husband has shown me receipts over and over, and the contractor always has some explanation, and I still feel like there’s something underneath it. Like they’re keeping the kitchen half-wrong on purpose and making it look like normal mistakes.

I’m sorry, I know that probably doesn’t sound like the answer I’m supposed to give, but no… I can’t really think of an explanation that would make me stop believing it.
Even though there’s no clear proof that the contractor and neighbors are working against you, do you feel deep down that you just know it’s true, in a way that no one else seems to understand?

Yes… I suppose that’s fair to say. I don’t want to sound stubborn or unreasonable, but deep down I do feel like I just know.

It’s been nearly two years, and I’ve been sure the contractor and some people on my block are quietly working together somehow—cheating us, keeping the kitchen not quite right on purpose. My husband shows me receipts and they all have reasons, but it doesn’t settle it for me. It feels like everyone else is missing what I can see.

Even though there’s no clear evidence that the contractor and neighbors are working against you, would you say that your belief about this feels completely certain and not something you could be mistaken about?

Yes… I mean, I know I should probably leave room for being wrong, and I don’t want you to think I’m impossible to talk to.

But if I’m being honest, it does feel certain to me. For nearly two years now I’ve been sure the contractor and some of the neighbors are quietly working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband can show me receipts, and they can give all their explanations, but it still doesn’t feel like normal mistakes to me. It feels like I know what’s really happening, even if other people don’t see it.

Even though there’s no clear evidence that the contractor and neighbors are working against you, would you say your belief about this is completely unshakable and not something you could possibly be mistaken about?

I… I know “unshakable” sounds so strong, and I don’t want to seem like I’m just refusing to listen. I really do listen.

But yes, if I’m being honest with you, it feels that way to me. I’ve been sure for nearly two years that the contractor and some people on my block are quietly working together to cheat us, keeping my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband shows me receipts, they all have explanations, but it just doesn’t change what I feel I know is happening.

I’m sorry if that sounds unreasonable. I’m just trying to answer you truthfully.
